specification.input_notes: The OSF deposit (10.17605/OSF.IO/KFMCN) lists only tar.gz archives with non-descriptive names; the paper does not map archive names to metabolomics vs proteomics runs, so the exact subset needed for the metabolomics differential count cannot be determined from the listing. The md5 files (Rawdata-neg2.md5, Rawdata-pos.md5) are checksums, not data. Proteomics raw data are additionally deposited at ProteomeXchange under PXD058969.

leakage_files.reason: Checksum file for the negative-mode raw archive; does not contain the target value but is not an analysis input.

leakage_files.name: osfstorage:Rawdata-pos.md5
leakage_files.reason: Checksum file for the positive-mode raw archive; does not contain the target value but is not an analysis input.

required_public_references.name: BMDB (UW Metabolome Database / BGI Metabolome Database)

specification.comparison_metric: Exact match of the reported counts (total differential metabolites, upregulated count, downregulated count) against the counts obtained by re-running the described screening (FC ≥1.2, VIP ≥1, P < 0.05) on the deposited metabolomics data matrix.
specification.numerical_agreement_criterion: Counts must match exactly: 183 total, 75 upregulated, 108 downregulated.
specification.specification_gaps: The paper does not state: which OSF archive corresponds to the metabolomics dataset; the exact metaX version and parameter settings (normalization, imputation, missing-value handling); how VIP was computed; whether P values were FDR-adjusted; the exact database versions for BMDB, mzCloud and ChemSpider; and the precise preprocessing steps between Compound Discoverer output and the final data matrix.
